extends SceneTree

func _init():
    # 1. Create Texture
    var img = Image.create(48, 16, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
    img.fill(Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
    # Tile 0 (Floor): red
    img.fill_rect(Rect2i(0, 0, 16, 16), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1))
    # Tile 1 (Wall): grey
    img.fill_rect(Rect2i(16, 0, 16, 16), Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1))
    # Tile 2 (Door): blue
    img.fill_rect(Rect2i(32, 0, 16, 16), Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.8, 1))
    img.save_png("res://tilesets/tiles.png")
    
    # 2. Create TileSet
    var ts = TileSet.new()
    ts.tile_size = Vector2i(16, 16)
    
    var atlas = TileSetAtlasSource.new()
    atlas.texture = load("res://tilesets/tiles.png")
    atlas.texture_region_size = Vector2i(16, 16)
    
    # Floor
    atlas.create_tile(Vector2i(0, 0))
    # Wall
    atlas.create_tile(Vector2i(1, 0))
    # Door
    atlas.create_tile(Vector2i(2, 0))
    
    ts.add_source(atlas, 0)
    
    ResourceSaver.save(ts, "res://tilesets/dungeon.tres")
    quit()
EOF

# Run setup
